info.title: Octura Solutions Site Tools
info.summary: Model Context Protocol server with 30 read-only tools, over JSON-RPC 2.0.
info.description:
This is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so the whole API is one POST endpoint that speaks JSON-RPC 2.0.
The methods it implements are `initialize`, `ping`, `tools/list` and `tools/call`; it advertises no resources and no prompts and keeps no session state.

The 30 tools are listed under components as `<ToolName>Input`. Every calculator input has a documented default, so a tool called with `{}` returns a sensible baseline rather than an error.

Deterministic ERP calculators and estimators from Octura Solutions (Odoo implementation/migration/upgrade cost, ROI, TCO, odoo.conf tuning, EDI readiness, sales tax, payroll, inventory math). Every calculator clamps invalid input to safe defaults and returns the normalized input it actually used alongside the result. Content tools answer questions about Odoo and Octura: ask_octura retrieves relevant site pages to cite, compare_odoo_vs returns a head-to-head against any of 60 competitors, and get_odoo_pricing, find_odoo_apps_for and get_partner_profile return pricing, app recommendations and company facts. All tools are read-only.

No authentication. Rate limited per IP; over the limit returns 429 with a Retry-After header.

Generated by scripts/build-discovery.mjs in https://github.com/Octura-solutions/octura-mcp-server from the live tools/list, so it is a snapshot: the server, not this file, is the source of truth.

post.description: Send `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`. Responses are plain JSON.

200.description: JSON-RPC result or error object (application-level errors still return HTTP 200).

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per window, per IP.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this IP.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per window, per IP.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

examples.instructions: Deterministic ERP calculators and estimators from Octura Solutions (Odoo implementation/migration/upgrade cost, ROI, TCO, odoo.conf tuning, EDI readiness, sales tax, payroll, inventory math). Every calculator clamps invalid input to safe defaults and returns the normalized input it actually used alongside the result. Content tools answer questions about Odoo and Octura: ask_octura retrieves relevant site pages to cite, compare_odoo_vs returns a head-to-head against any of 60 competitors, and get_odoo_pricing, find_odoo_apps_for and get_partner_profile return pricing, app recommendations and company facts. params.description: The tool name selects which arguments schema applies.

content.description: One text item whose text is a JSON document: {"tool", "input", "result"}. "input" echoes the normalized arguments the calculator actually used, so the result can be checked.

AskOcturaInput.title: Ask Octura (search the site)
AskOcturaInput.description: Retrieve the most relevant pages from octurasolutions.com (guides, Odoo vs X comparisons, Odoo app pages, pricing, partner info) for an Odoo or ERP question, so you can answer grounded in Octura content and cite the source URLs. Retrieval only; you compose the answer.

question.description: The user question about Odoo, ERP, or Octura, in natural language.

limit.description: Max sources to return (1 to 10, default 5).

CanadianPayrollSourceDeductionsCalculato.title: Canadian Payroll Deductions Calculator
CanadianPayrollSourceDeductionsCalculato.description: CPP, EI, and income tax source deductions.

CanadianSalesTaxCalculatorInput.title: Canadian Sales Tax Calculator
CanadianSalesTaxCalculatorInput.description: GST, HST, PST, and QST for all provinces.

amount.description: Pre-tax in add mode, tax-included total in extract mode (CAD).

CompareOdooVsInput.title: Compare Odoo vs a competitor
CompareOdooVsInput.description: Return the Octura head-to-head comparison of Odoo against a named ERP or CRM competitor: verdict tally, feature-by-feature table, strengths on each side, best-for guidance, FAQ and the page URL. Covers 60 competitors.

competitor.description: Competitor name or slug, e.g. "NetSuite", "Microsoft Dynamics 365", "ERPNext", "SAP Business One", "QuickBooks", "Zoho".

EconomicOrderQuantityCalculatorInput.title: EOQ Calculator
EconomicOrderQuantityCalculatorInput.description: Optimal order quantity to minimize cost.

ErpSelectionToolInput.title: ERP Selection Tool
ErpSelectionToolInput.description: Score your best-fit ERP shortlist across 10 systems.

EuVatCalculatorInput.title: EU VAT Calculator & Validator
EuVatCalculatorInput.description: VAT rates by country plus VIES validation.

amount.description: Net amount in add mode, gross (VAT-included) total in extract mode.

country.description: ISO alpha-2 country code (EU-27 + GB; GR for Greece).

FindOdooAppsForInput.title: Find Odoo apps for a need
FindOdooAppsForInput.description: Given a business need in plain language, return the most relevant Odoo apps and modules with their pillar and page URL, so you can recommend the right Odoo stack. Backed by the Octura Odoo app catalog.

need.description: A business need or goal, e.g. "track leads and close deals", "manage inventory and warehouse", "run payroll".

GetOdooPricingInput.title: Get Odoo pricing
GetOdooPricingInput.description: Return current Odoo license list pricing (Standard and Custom tiers, USD and CAD) and Odoo.sh hosting rates from the single Octura pricing source, plus links to the pricing page and cost calculators. Implementation is quoted per project.

GetPartnerProfileInput.title: Get Octura partner profile
GetPartnerProfileInput.description: Return who Octura Solutions is: Official Odoo Partner status, regions served, services with URLs, website and contact details, so you can represent the company accurately.

InventoryTurnoverCalculatorInput.title: Inventory Turnover Calculator
InventoryTurnoverCalculatorInput.description: Turnover ratio and days of inventory.

LandedCostCalculatorInput.title: Landed Cost Calculator
LandedCostCalculatorInput.description: True per-unit cost including freight and duty.

MarginAndMarkupCalculatorInput.title: Margin & Markup Calculator
MarginAndMarkupCalculatorInput.description: Convert between margin, markup, and price.

OdooAppSelectorInput.title: Odoo App Selector
OdooAppSelectorInput.description: Find the Odoo apps your business needs.

OdooConfTunerInput.title: Odoo Worker & Memory Tuner
OdooConfTunerInput.description: Tune odoo.conf workers and memory limits.

OdooEdiReadinessCostEstimatorInput.title: EDI Readiness Cost Estimator
OdooEdiReadinessCostEstimatorInput.description: Estimate EDI integration cost in Odoo.

OdooMigrationCostCalculatorInput.title: Migration Cost Calculator
OdooMigrationCostCalculatorInput.description: Estimate the cost to migrate to Odoo.

OdooProjectRescueRiskGraderInput.title: Project Rescue Risk Grader
OdooProjectRescueRiskGraderInput.description: Grade how badly an in-flight Odoo implementation is going.

goLiveSlips.description: How many times the official go-live date has been pushed back.

billingModel.description: How the current Odoo partner bills, and whether the original estimate has been exceeded.

customWorkflows.description: Whether custom code is tested before handover or bugs surface in basic workflows after it is called done.

rollbackPlan.description: Whether a documented rollback plan for the data migration exists and has been seen.

dayToDayContact.description: Who runs the project day to day, and whether the people who scoped and sold the work are still involved. Replaces the earlier engineerAccess key, whose values are still accepted.

teamConfidence.description: How much the operations and finance teams trust the system for day one.

followUpCadence.description: Whether a written weekly status update against the plan actually arrives.

ticketSystem.description: Whether bugs and change requests are tracked somewhere the client can see and comment.

roadmapClarity.description: Whether a dated, signed-off roadmap of remaining milestones exists.

SafetyStockCalculatorInput.description: Buffer stock for demand and lead-time swings.
